description: The interior control moves 2 up. The curve passes through (0,0,0), (4,2,0) and (8,0,0) with every tangent (8,0,0). Each half is a Hermite segment with parameter span h = 0.5, and the joints at u = 0.25 and 0.75 sit at the middle of a segment (t = 0.5), where the point is the average of the segment's ends because the tangent terms cancel: (2,1,0) and (6,1,0). The slope there is dP/du = 3 (P1 - P0) - 0.25 (m0 + m1) with h = 0.5: (12,6,0) - (4,0,0) = (8,6,0), so the joint turns atan2(6,8) = 36.8699 degrees. The second half mirrors it (-36.8699). At the control the slope is the tangent (8,0,0), so no turn.
